title: Data Scientist
description: We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong Python, pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn skills. Experience with machine learning, statistics, data visualization (Matplotlib, Tableau) and SQL is required. Knowledge of deep learning with TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus. You will build predictive models, run A/B tests and communicate insights.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build NLP pipelines for text classification, named entity recognition and sentiment analysis. Required: Python, NLP, spaCy, NLTK, transformers, Hugging Face, BERT, PyTorch. Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, LangChain and vector databases is desirable. Deploy models using FastAPI and Docker.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design, train and deploy machine learning and deep learning models. Skills: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, computer vision, OpenCV, CNN, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS. Experience with model monitoring, Git and CI/CD pipelines preferred.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Develop responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and TypeScript. Knowledge of Redux, Tailwind CSS, REST API integration and Git is expected. Understanding of UI/UX principles and Figma is a plus.

title: Backend Developer
description: Build scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot, REST API and microservices. Work with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and Git is required. Knowledge of Kafka is a plus.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Full stack development using the MERN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, React and Node.js. Strong JavaScript, HTML, CSS and REST API skills. Experience with Git, Docker and AWS deployment. TypeScript knowledge preferred.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyse business data using SQL, Excel, Python and pandas. Create dashboards in Power BI or Tableau. Strong statistics and data visualization skills, attention to detail and good communication required.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Manage CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, AWS or Azure, Linux and shell scripting. Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana. Python scripting is a plus.

title: Android Developer
description: Develop Android applications using Kotlin and Java with Android Studio. Knowledge of Jetpack Compose, Firebase, REST API, SQLite and Git. Experience with Flutter is an advantage.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Monitor and protect systems against threats. Skills: network security, penetration testing, Wireshark, Linux, firewalls, SIEM, ethical hacking, Python scripting and cryptography. Certifications such as CEH are a plus.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description: Build LLM-powered applications using Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face transformers, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vector databases such as FAISS or ChromaDB, prompt engineering and FastAPI. Understanding of NLP and deep learning fundamentals required.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Design and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure. Skills: EC2, S3, Lambda, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, networking and Python scripting. GCP knowledge preferred.

title: Java Developer
description: Develop enterprise applications in Java using Spring Boot, Hibernate and JSP/Servlets. Work with REST API, microservices, MySQL and Oracle databases. Knowledge of Maven, Git, JUnit and agile development required.

title: Python Developer
description: Write clean Python code for backend applications using Django and Flask. Build REST API services, work with PostgreSQL and MySQL, write unit tests and use Git. Knowledge of pandas, Linux and Docker is a plus.

title: Web Designer
description: Design attractive websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap and jQuery. Create layouts in Photoshop and Figma, build WordPress sites and ensure responsive design and basic SEO. PHP knowledge is a plus.

title: HR Executive
description: Handle end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, payroll processing and employee engagement activities. Maintain HRMS records, manage performance appraisal and ensure labour law compliance. Proficiency in MS Excel required.

title: Big Data Engineer
description: Build big data pipelines using Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Pig, HBase and Sqoop. Programming in Scala, Python and SQL. Experience with Kafka, data warehousing, Linux and AWS EMR is desirable.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Create 2D and 3D designs using AutoCAD, SolidWorks and CATIA. Perform analysis in ANSYS, prepare GD&T drawings, support manufacturing, quality control and production planning. Knowledge of lean manufacturing is a plus.

title: Sales Executive
description: Generate leads, conduct client meetings and close B2B sales deals. Maintain customer records in CRM and Salesforce, achieve sales targets, perform market research and negotiation. Excellent communication skills required.

title: Operations Manager
description: Oversee daily operations, supply chain, logistics and inventory management. Drive process improvement using Six Sigma and lean methodologies, manage budgeting, vendor management and team leadership. MS Excel and ERP knowledge required.

title: ETL Developer
description: Design and develop ETL workflows using Informatica, Talend and SSIS. Strong SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle and SQL Server skills. Experience with data warehousing, data modeling and shell scripting on Linux.

title: Blockchain Developer
description: Develop decentralised applications and smart contracts using Solidity on Ethereum. Experience with Web3.js, Hyperledger, cryptography, Node.js and JavaScript. Understanding of consensus algorithms and Truffle is desirable.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Create visual content for print and digital media using Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW and InDesign. Video editing in Premiere Pro, strong sense of typography, branding and creativity required.

title: Database Administrator
description: Install, configure and maintain Oracle, MySQL and SQL Server databases. Strong SQL and PL/SQL, performance tuning, backup and recovery, database security and Linux shell scripting. Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MongoDB is a plus.

title: Fitness Trainer
description: Conduct personal training sessions, design workout plans and provide nutrition guidance. Certified in fitness training, yoga and first aid. Strong communication and client motivation skills.

title: Electrical Engineer
description: Design and maintain electrical systems, power distribution and control panels. Work with PLC, SCADA, AutoCAD Electrical and MATLAB. Knowledge of power systems, electrical design, testing and commissioning required.

title: Project Manager (PMO)
description: Manage project planning, scheduling, budgeting and risk management across IT programs. Track progress with MS Project and JIRA, run agile and scrum ceremonies, handle stakeholder management and reporting. PMP certification preferred.

title: Business Analyst
description: Gather and document business requirements, create BRD, FRD and use cases. Perform requirements gathering, gap analysis, data analysis with SQL and Excel, create dashboards in Power BI and work with stakeholders in agile teams using JIRA.

title: .NET Developer
description: Develop web applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET Core and Entity Framework. Work with SQL Server, REST API, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Experience with Azure and Git preferred.

title: Automation Test Engineer
description: Build automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver with Java or Python, TestNG, JUnit and Cucumber. Perform API testing with Postman, regression testing, CI/CD integration with Jenkins and defect tracking in JIRA.

title: Software Tester (QA)
description: Perform manual testing, write test cases and test plans, execute functional, regression and integration testing. Log defects in JIRA, understand SDLC and STLC, basic SQL. Exposure to Selenium is a plus.

title: Civil Site Engineer
description: Supervise construction site activities, quantity estimation, billing and quality checks. Prepare drawings in AutoCAD, structural analysis in STAAD Pro, use Revit and MS Project for planning. Knowledge of IS codes required.

title: SAP Consultant
description: Implement and support SAP modules including SAP FICO, SAP MM and SAP SD. Knowledge of SAP ABAP, SAP HANA, configuration, end-user training and requirements gathering. S/4HANA experience preferred.

title: Legal Associate (Advocate)
description: Handle litigation, legal drafting, contract drafting and legal research. Represent clients in court, advise on corporate law, civil law and compliance matters. Enrolled with the Bar Council of India.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build data pipelines using Python, SQL, Spark and Airflow. Work with data warehousing on Snowflake or BigQuery, AWS, Kafka and ETL processes. Docker and Git knowledge required.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description: Plan and run digital marketing campaigns: SEO, social media marketing, Google Ads and email marketing. Track results with Google Analytics, write content and copywriting for campaigns.

title: Content Writer
description: Write blogs, articles and website content. Strong content writing, copywriting, SEO, proofreading and research skills. Familiarity with WordPress and social media marketing is a plus.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Design user interfaces and experiences using Figma and Adobe XD. Conduct user research, create wireframing and prototyping deliverables, usability testing and design systems. Basic HTML and CSS knowledge preferred.

title: iOS Developer
description: Develop iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI in Xcode. Integrate REST API, Core Data, Firebase and push notifications. Git and App Store deployment experience required.

title: Accountant
description: Maintain books of accounts in Tally, GST filing, TDS, bank reconciliation and financial reporting. Strong accounting, taxation and MS Excel skills. Knowledge of financial analysis is a plus.

title: Financial Analyst
description: Perform financial analysis, financial modeling, budgeting and forecasting. Prepare valuation reports using Excel, Power BI and SQL. CFA or MBA Finance preferred.

title: Product Manager
description: Own the product roadmap, gather requirements, write user stories and prioritise features. Work with agile scrum teams, conduct user research, market research and A/B testing. Track metrics with SQL and Google Analytics; JIRA experience required.

title: Network Engineer
description: Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches and firewalls. Knowledge of TCP/IP, routing and switching, VPN, LAN/WAN, CCNA, network security and Linux. Wireshark experience is a plus.

title: Customer Support Executive
description: Resolve customer queries over phone, email and chat. Use CRM tools like Zendesk and Freshdesk, maintain ticket records, strong communication and problem solving. MS Excel basics required.
